commercial.rentRoll: Eight two-bedrooms, all month-to-month since the last owner stopped bothering with paper.

hiddenIssues.desc: Six of the eight units are on month-to-month tenancies about $180 under market, and three have been here a decade
One boiler serving all eight units, 1978, and the parts are eBay-only now
The rear stair is exterior wood and the treads have gone spongy

blurb: Eight units off the mill trail, full and cheap and loose. Every lease in the building is a handshake.
